Upstream catchments on bundled synthetic data

checks.name: Catchment land cover on bundled synthetic data
checks.sql: SELECT sum(area_m2), min(coverage_fraction) FROM hydrology.main.landcover((SELECT station_id, geometry_wkb FROM hydrology.main.catchments((SELECT * FROM hydrology.main.demo_input)) WHERE status='ok'))

checks.name: Multiple input batches preserve unknown coverage
checks.sql: SELECT count(*), count(geometry_wkb), min(status) FROM hydrology.main.catchments((SELECT i::VARCHAR station_id, 0.0 x, 0.0 y FROM range(2501) t(i)))

checks.name: Join upstream facilities to catchments
checks.sql:
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
WITH basins AS (SELECT * FROM hydrology.main.catchments((SELECT * FROM hydrology.main.demo_input))),
facilities(facility_id, x, y) AS (VALUES ('upstream-plant', 500015.0, 4100055.0), ('outside-plant', 500095.0, 4100055.0))
SELECT b.station_id, f.facility_id, b.area_m2, b.boundary_limited
FROM basins b JOIN facilities f ON ST_Covers(ST_GeomFromWKB(b.geometry_wkb), ST_Point(f.x, f.y))
ORDER BY b.station_id, f.facility_id
